title: 'The first time I win a combat each turn, you score 1 point.' never fires
expected: parseAbilities on Draven's rulesText yields only [Deflect keyword, {type:'spell', effect:score opponent 1}] — no win-combat trigger; packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/trigger-patterns.ts:40 only matches /^When I win a combat,/ so 'The first time I win a combat each turn' is unparsed. Additionally, grep shows no non-test emitter of a 'win-combat' GameEvent anywhere in riftbound-engine (only type decls at abilities/game-events.ts:85, trigger-matcher.ts:149, events/dispatcher.ts:97), and __tests__/core-rules/combat-flow-and-resolution.test.ts:216 is a test.failing acknowledging the engine never emits win-combat.
observed: player-1 VP went 0->1 (conquer only); no chain item/trigger, log only 'Combat resolved'. Root cause: parseAbilities(rulesText) yields only [Deflect keyword, {type:'spell', effect:{type:'score',player:'opponent',amount:1}}] — no win-combat triggered ability; additionally engine never emits a 'win-combat' event from resolve-full-combat (repo has a test.failing acknowledging this).
